qualification.new_identity: own A/B original E30 then E60 before formal mechanism/heldout; exact identical qualified identities may reuse

concurrency.GPU: batch model fits, candidate prediction and imagination; one or two trainers only as measured productive; no memory-fill target
concurrency.other_projects: check and respect current load; downshift new admission rather than kill valid jobs

delivery.originals: D57 directly to Release; verify size/digest
